name: Dimitri Volkov
bio:
Dimitri's journey into motorsport logistics began unconventionally, trading auto parts in his youth before becoming fascinated by the intricate choreography required to move racing teams and equipment across continents. His career took off after successfully managing the logistics for a regional rally team, known for its ambitious yet underfunded expeditions. Dimitri's approach is rooted in pragmatism and meticulous planning, viewing every logistical challenge as a puzzle with a single, optimal solution.

Years of experience have taught him to anticipate problems before they arise, and his network within the motorsport world is extensive. He is highly regarded for his ability to secure difficult-to-obtain permits and navigate complex customs regulations. What sets Dimitri apart is his unwavering commitment to efficiency, always seeking ways to streamline operations and reduce costs without compromising reliability or safety. He operates best independently, a seasoned professional who delivers results through individual effort and deep understanding of his field.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Dimitri is of average height with a sturdy build, reflecting years spent handling equipment and navigating challenging environments.

quirks: Insists on using a paper planner, even with digital tools available.
Always carries a small, well-worn copy of a Russian logistics manual.
Has a habit of muttering calculations and probabilities under his breath.
